served: video-EEG monitoring of a typical event
results: 1. interictal EEG: intermittent sharp waves from the LEFT FRONTAL to anterior temporal regions
2. video-EEG monitoring of a typical event: moderate-amplitude rhythmic THETA waves intermittently during the versive seizures
3. provocation testing (the suspected trigger): supervised shadowboxing of 3 minutes per trial reproduced the seizures, with induction latencies of about 11 seconds and durations around 18 seconds
